== Notes ==
* If Power Block interrupts a [[PvE-only skill]] or one without a linked attribute, ''only'' that skill will be disabled; the target will still be able to use other title-track or [[no attribute]] skills.
* [[Wastrel's Worry]] and [[Wastrel's Demise]] are good sources of unconditional damage during the period that Power Block disables skills, especially against single-attribute builds (e.g. [[nuker]]s).
* Power Block will extend the recharge time of skills with a shorter disable/recharge time (skills with a longer downtime will not be affected).
* Disables skills even if interruption is prevented.
